title: Camera-fit math exists as two independent copies (command bus vs view) with no shared source of truth
detail: Input screen→grid and render grid→screen must be exact inverses; each is maintained by hand in a different file. Any future view change (margin, new design size) silently desynchronizes drag positions from what is drawn.
recommended_fix: Extract one camera-fit helper (e.g. PPView::FCameraFit with Compute(ViewportSize) and both ToScreen/ToGrid) in PPViewSnapshot.h and use it from PPCommandBus, PPRunGameMode, and PPRunView.

title: StartRun hand-copies the golden fixture instead of sharing PP_Scenario's builder — the 'SAME topology' claim rests on literal duplication
evidence:
PPRunGameMode.cpp:31-33:
	PP::SpawnNode(SimState.Topology, PP::FNodeKind::Terminal, 2, 2);  // SCENARIO_SOURCE
	PP::SpawnNode(SimState.Topology, PP::FNodeKind::Junction, 6, 2);  // SCENARIO_ROUTER
	PP::SpawnNode(SimState.Topology, PP::FNodeKind::Terminal, 10, 2); // SCENARIO_SINK
PP_Scenario.h:48-50 (BuildProbeScenario):
	SpawnNode(State.Topology, FNodeKind::Terminal, 2, 2);  // SCENARIO_SOURCE
	SpawnNode(State.Topology, FNodeKind::Junction, 6, 2);  // SCENARIO_ROUTER
	SpawnNode(State.Topology, FNodeKind::Terminal, 10, 2); // SCENARIO_SINK
PP_Scenario.h defines no position constants — only SCENARIO_SOURCE/ROUTER/SINK node ids — so the trailing '(PP_Scenario.h constants)' comments reference constants that do not exist for positions.
detail: PIE topology and the golden scenario stay identical only while two hardcoded copies stay in sync; PP_Scenario.h's whole stated purpose (UAD-17) is preventing exactly this drift between surfaces.
recommended_fix: Add SpawnScenarioFixture(FTopology&) to PP_Scenario.h (node spawns only) and call it from both BuildProbeScenario and APPRunGameMode::StartRun.

title: Snap quantizes the cursor to its tile cell before the radius test, so the E4 'world px, inclusive' snap is really a 5-tile plus-shape
detail: The compare is exact only for the floored tile cell, not the cursor position; the effective snap region deviates from the documented 36px-inclusive disk at both edges (misses diagonals, overshoots orthogonally).
recommended_fix: Snap in world-px space: convert the cursor to a fixed-point/sub-tile position (or scale GridPos by kTilePx before flooring is lost) and compare cursor-px to node-center-px against kSnapRadius²; or document the tile-cell snap as the slice-1 approximation.

title: EndDraw's 'immediate refresh' BuildSnapshot() is a no-op for the view — the view only rebuilds when Tick changes
detail: A drawn pipe first renders at the next sim tick (≤50ms), not 'THIS frame'; the immediate BuildSnapshot() call changes nothing observable and the two adjacent comments contradict each other.
recommended_fix: Drop the BuildSnapshot() call and keep only the accurate 'view refreshes on the next step' comment — or make the view's change detection content-aware (e.g. a snapshot serial) if true same-frame feedback is wanted.

title: StartRun demand comment says 'every 20 ticks (1 s)' but the loop seeds a packet every 10 ticks (0.5 s at 20 Hz)
detail: Comment and code disagree by 2x on the demand cadence; anyone tuning pacing from the comment will be misled about expected packet density.
recommended_fix: Fix the comment to 'every 10 ticks (0.5 s)' or change the stride to 20 if the 1 s cadence was the intent.

title: New API/state with no consumers: GetCommandBus(), LastEditError/bHasLastEditError, and an unused forward declaration
detail: Dead surface added speculatively: the 'rejection feedback' the comments promise is not wired to any view, and the forward declaration serves nothing.
recommended_fix: Either wire LastEditError into the PPRunView status line (expose a getter) and use GetCommandBus from the MCP bridge now, or delete both plus the stray forward declaration until a consumer lands.

title: PPProbe routing dump prints slot indices as from/dst labels but node IDs for hops — two identifier spaces in one line
detail: Slot and id spaces diverge once demolish tombstones arrive (story 2.3), making the diagnostic dump mislabel from/dst pairs while hops stay id-based.
recommended_fix: Print Rt's from/dst via Topology.NodeId[From]/NodeId[Dst] so every label in the dump is a node id.
